points.description: Meter table: states that it holds meter entries per flow / collects flow statistics, used for network management such as QoS operations (e.g., rate-limiting). Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Award 0.25 if the meter table is mentioned as holding per-flow meter entries/statistics but no link to QoS/rate-limiting/management is given (or vice versa).

points.description: Flow pipeline: states that it consists of flow tables containing rules/fields (match entries) that determine how packets are processed, i.e. actions to be taken on packets.
Flow pipeline: states that this is for packet forwarding / implements the routing/forwarding logic in the switch.
